messages:
Mira: Quick sync — LangChain + NimbusSI want to co-announce a marketplace bundle + joint demo. Proposed announce date: 2025-01-12. Need demo env, marketplace SKU, partner quote, and one-page joint blog. Can we align?
Jamal: +1. Legal needs logos and CLA by Dec 20. Who owns partner quote?
Olivia: I can draft the quote and one-pager. Need a short product call to agree messaging and metrics to highlight. Also, confirm SOC2/data residency expectations for Nimbus customers.
Chen: For the demo env, we can spin a private preview in eu-west1 with VPC peering. Will need Nimbus network contacts and an onboarding playbook. Can Nimbus share a test tenant and an allowlist for IPs?
Evan: Demo runbook idea — keep it tiny: 1) import a 100k doc sample, 2) run gateway pipeline with LangChain adapter, 3) show latency + cost dashboard and a rerank comparison. I'll draft scripts. Sample curl to trigger pipeline: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"pipeline":"demo"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/run`
Mira: Perfect. Olivia — can you own the one-pager and partner quote? Jamal — legal to get logos/CLA? Chen — start the test tenant request and share onboarding doc.
Olivia: I'll take quote + one-pager. Draft ready by Dec 5 and will ping @mira for review before sending to Nimbus.
Jamal: Legal will reach out to Nimbus legal lead (nimbus-legal@si.com). I'll add the standard CLA + data handling appendix for demo data.
PartnerOps-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing templates are in /docs/marketplace/listing-template.md — please complete fields and attach partner logos by Dec 15.
Chen: Noted. I'll open a workspace invite for Nimbus engineers and add a networking checklist (VPN, peering CIDRs, firewall rules).
Evan: Quick ask — can we get a sandbox model variant pinned to 8k context for the preview window to avoid timeouts during the demo? Also will need a short token quota bump.
Mira: Yes — @eng-runtime team, please pin an 8k model variant for the preview window Jan 6–Feb 6 and provision the requested quota. Chen will coordinate capacity with you.
Olivia: Also we should schedule a rehearsal week of Jan 6. Who can lead the run-through and handle slide + demo handoff?
Evan: I can run rehearsals and do smoke tests. Suggest two 45-min slots (one tech, one run-through).
Mira: OK. Action items recap: Olivia (quote + one-pager) by Dec 5; Jamal (logos/CLA) by Dec 20; Chen (test tenant + peering checklist) by Dec 15; Evan (runbook + rehearsals) by Jan 6; Mira (announce coordination + press contact). We'll start weekly check-ins next Tue. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
